snippet.title: Stop the Press! Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
STOP THE PRESS! is a game about running a newspaper in a time of revolutions. Twist headlines, upgrade your printing press, get more readers, evade censorship… and exert your influence on history.
Wishlist on Steam now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3989650/Stop_the_Press/?utm_source=youtube
